metaDescription: Notis follows the municipal councils and committees, and messages you on WhatsApp when something concerns you.
pickerMetaTitle: Know what happens in your municipality | OpenCouncil
pickerMetaDescription: Pick your municipality and Notis messages you on WhatsApp when something at the council concerns you.
pickerTitle: Know what happens in your municipality
lead: Notis follows the municipal councils and committees, and lets you know when something concerns you.
introNote: He writes only when something concerns you — most weeks, nothing. One STOP ends it, whenever you like.
alreadySubscribedBody: You are already on the list. The next steps change what concerns you and where he writes.

preferencesLead.municipality: Home, work, or any other place in the municipality. Notis writes when something happens nearby.
preferencesLead.region: Home, work, or any other place in the region. Notis writes when something happens nearby.

places.privacy: A street, an area or an address is enough. You can remove it any time.
places.mapHint: Pick an area to see what was discussed nearby.

noResults.municipality: No match for “{query}” in {qualifier}. Try a street or a square.
noResults.region: No match for “{query}” in {qualifier}. Try a street or a square.

places.searchFailed: Search is not responding right now. Try again in a moment.
places.locateDenied: Location access was not allowed. Search for the area above.
places.locateFailed: Your location could not be found. Search for the area above.

locateOutside.municipality: Your location is outside {qualifier}. Search for the area above.
locateOutside.region: Your location is outside {qualifier}. Search for the area above.

nearby.empty: Nothing nearby in the latest meetings. Notis will write when something comes up.
nearby.emptySince: Nothing discussed nearby in the meetings since {date}. Notis will write when something comes up.

topics.title: Topics you care about
topics.footer: Optional. With none chosen, Notis decides on his own.

channelsLead: On your phone, by email, or both.
phoneChannelBlurb: Notis writes when something concerns you and answers when you ask.
phoneHint: <free>Completely free.</free> No WhatsApp? It works over SMS.
emailChannelBlurb: Before and after each meeting, with more items than you get on your phone.
accountHint: So you can change your preferences.
consent: One STOP ends it, whenever you like. Notis's messages are written with artificial intelligence.
doneTitle: Notis will write to you shortly
doneTitleEmailOnly: Done — we will write to you by email
doneLead: The first message reaches {phone} in a few minutes — or in the morning, if it is late.
doneLeadEmailOnly: After every meeting that concerns you, a summary at {email}.
doneLeadKnown: Your changes are saved. The next message to {phone} comes with the next meeting that concerns you.
firstMessageBody: Η εγγραφή σου στις ειδοποιήσεις του OpenCouncil ολοκληρώθηκε. Σε αυτόν τον αριθμό θα σε ενημερώνει ο Νότης, ο βοηθός του OpenCouncil, για τις συνεδριάσεις του δήμου σου — μόνο όταν κάτι σε αφορά. Για ερωτήσεις σχετικά με τον δήμο σου ή τις ειδοποιήσεις σου, απάντησε σε αυτό το μήνυμα.
meanwhilePreferencesHint: Places, topics and channels, from your profile
doneStop: One STOP ends it, whenever you like.
noCityCta: Ask for your municipality to be supported
pickerChannels: Notifications arrive by WhatsApp or SMS — and by email, if you like.
